missing_brand: Brand is not named in the title or description, and the text does not say that the brand is unknown.
missing_size: No size in the title or description (not applicable for accessories without size).
missing_eu_size: The brand is from outside the EU (see non_eu_brands) and no EU size number or EU equivalent is given. Shoe sizes in EU numbers and children's sizes in cm (e.g. 128) count as EU sizes.
missing_fit_note: Nothing helps the buyer judge the fit: no seller size/height note, no measurements of the item or of the wearer, and no statement like 'runs small/large' or 'fits XS-S'. A description of the cut alone (e.g. 'figurbetont') does not count.
missing_color: Colour is not named in the title or description.
missing_condition: The description does not state the condition in words (e.g. neu, sehr gut, einmal getragen). 'See photos' alone does not count.
missing_defects_statement: For used items: the description neither describes defects nor says explicitly that there are none (e.g. keine Mängel, keine Flecken, ohne Gebrauchsspuren). New items do not need it.
missing_storage_note: No note about a non-smoking (and pet-free) household.
missing_contact_invite: No invitation to ask questions or request measurements/photos.
